description: Attach an evidence item to an open dispute. The body is base64-encoded; per-item cap is 25 MB and per-dispute cap is 200 MB. Either the filing buyer or the seller-owner can upload.

body_b64.description: File contents, base64-encoded. Max 25 MB per item.

caption.description: Optional caption shown alongside the evidence item.

dispute_id.description: UUID of the open dispute to attach evidence to.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. 'image/jpeg'.

name: disputes_add_evidence
title: Disputes add evidence
